Ticket 2 says: "Invoice PDF has the wrong date" — status open, no description, just the title. I added the note "looking at it" to it.

Heads-up: this repo has no invoice/PDF code (only cart.py, pricing.py, report.py, cli.py, tests/), so the wrong-date bug can't be tracked down here without more info. What date is wrong (issue date, due date), what it shows vs. what it should show?
